item.text: The failing test confirms the cause: JSDOM finds the button in the DOM, but excludes it from accessible role queries because its parent `<dialog>` lacks `open`. A small JSDOM check also shows that an open dialog and a `div` with `role="dialog"` expose the button. I’ll put host selection in `Dialog` and keep the host open through `ModalTwo`’s exit animation.
